releases.body:
Local, read-only browser for OpenCode session history.

**Install**

```
opencode plugin add opencode-session-explorer
```

**What's in 0.1.0**

- Transcript reader: newest-first or oldest-first paging, per-day timeline, questions-only view, collapsible reasoning and tool calls, in-page highlight
- Full-text search over messages, reasoning, tool output and attachment names, with jump-to-hit
- Session info: cost, token breakdown, composition, per-day volume, child sessions, last todo list
- Stats by day, working directory and model
- Export: Markdown, plain text, JSON, and a work report grouped by day
- Bilingual UI (EN/ZH) with instant switching; localised reports
- Read-only `opencode.db`, separate sidecar index, loopback-only with optional access token
